note: Medicine Bow NF campground in open ponderosa at the base of Laramie Peak (Douglas Ranger District), about 1.5 hours from Douglas by WY-94, County Road 5 and Forest Roads 671/661; the Bear Creek Road approach from Rock River is single-lane and rough. The Laramie Peak Connector Trail leaves from camp; the motorized Laramie Peak trailhead is a quarter mile away. Fishing in Friend Creek and its beaver ponds. --Claude
